description: This file defines the ClaimEventDecorator class, which adds additional behavior or interface around the ClaimEvent entity, related to handling claim events within the OrangeHRM system. It utilizes traits for ORM helper functions and provides methods to interact with ClaimEvent and associated User entities.

classes.name: ClaimEventDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for ClaimEvent entities, providing methods to set associated user entities based on user IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a specific ClaimEvent instance.

methods.name: getClaimEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the ClaimEvent object being decorated.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Sets the user associated with the claim event by user ID.
